Fishing

Fishing is a quiet way to find food without hunting. The rod costs a few boards, reeds and fiber, never wears out and needs no bait, and every catch is a piece of Raw meat.

Updated 8 November 2026 · 5 min read · Everyone · feature ledger · all guides

Make and equip a rod

In Survival, craft a Reed fishing rod in E > Craft > Tools & arms. It costs 4 boards of any species, 4 Reeds and 2 Plant fiber, and Wool can stand in for the fiber. Counts are half-metre pieces, as everywhere in the Craft tab. Fishing with the Reed fishing rod Interchangeable ingredients

Tools & arms 1 recipes
RecipeMakesNeeds
Reed fishing rod1× Reed fishing rod
  • 4× Boards of any species (mixable)
  • 4× Reeds
  • 2× Plant fiber or Wool (mixable)

Reeds grow in wetlands. Plant fiber comes from Wild flax, which grows in some meadows of newer worlds; older worlds have none, so use Wool there. Wool comes from sheep. Where crafting materials come from

A rod you craft is equipped at once. Otherwise press Tab (or Shift + Tab) until the status line says Equipped Reed fishing rod, click the rod in the Pack, or bind it to a hotbar slot and select that slot. Equipping tools (Tab cycling)

In Creative, click the Reed fishing rod in the Build catalogue: you take one and it is equipped. Fishing works the same way there, and the Raw meat still goes into your pack. On a server, fishing needs Survival; see the last section. Creative catalog (Build tab)

Tip. Fishing uses nothing up. The rod does not wear out, and there is no bait.

Cast, wait and reel in

  1. Stand by open water and aim at its surface, no more than 12 m away.
  2. Right click to cast. The status line says Line cast | wait for a bite; RMB reels in, LMB cancels, and a small cream-and-red float sits on the water at the end of a thin line.
  3. Wait 2 to 4 seconds for a bite. The status line says A bite! Reel in when ready.
  4. Right click to reel in. The status line names the catch, for example Caught a trout | +1 Raw meat, and you hear the usual pickup sound.
Key or actionWhat it does
Right clickCast. After a bite, reel in. Before a bite it changes nothing and shows Waiting for a bite.
Left clickCancel the line: Fishing line cancelled.

The hotbar shows the rod's state, Ready to cast, Waiting for a bite or A bite! Reel in when ready, with the hint RMB CAST/REEL / LMB CANCEL. A bite never gets away: the fish waits on the line until you reel in or cancel.

Good to know. There is no bite sound, and the float does not move when a fish bites. Watch the status line or the hotbar.
Careful. While the rod is equipped it takes both mouse buttons, so you cannot mine, place blocks or hit animals. At a boat's helm the rod does nothing; press V to leave the helm first. Selecting a block or another tool puts the rod away and cancels the line.

Where you can fish

Your cast lands on the first thing your aim meets within 12 m. Three kinds of water take a line: Where to fish and what you catch

  • Fresh water, in lakes, rivers and most inland wetlands.
  • Sea Water, in the ocean and along coasts.
  • Black water, in warm, very wet lowlands such as bayous.

Ice of any kind, Hot spring water, Boiling water and Dark fjord water do not take a line. Nor do Water lilies, Kelp, reeds or other plants in the water, or grass on the bank between you and the water: aim past them at open water. Depth, time of day, weather and season make no difference.

  • Aim at open water within 12 m to cast: your aim meets nothing within 12 m.
  • Fish in open fresh, sea or black water: your aim meets something else first, such as ground, a plant or ice.

Once the line is out you can look around and walk a little. The line is cancelled if you move more than 16 m from the float (Fishing line cancelled | too far from the water) or if the water under the float changes, for example when a block is placed there (Fishing line cancelled | the water changed). Opening the inventory does not cancel it.

What you catch

Every catch is 1 Raw meat; the fish only changes the message. Which fish it is depends on the water and on the biome where the float lands:

  • Fresh water: carp, sometimes trout. In Pine highlands, Snowy tundra, Snowy peaks, Frozen lake, Frozen fjord and Rocky highlands it is the other way round: trout, sometimes carp.
  • Sea water: salmon, sometimes crab. In Coral shallows, Mangrove coast, Gravel shore, Shell beach and Tide pools it is crab, sometimes salmon.
  • Black water: always catfish.

"Sometimes" means about one cast in three. The catch is chosen when you cast. Fishing does not take animals out of the water, and you do not need to see a fish to catch one.

Good to know. There is no fish item, bait, rare catch or better rod. The game treats its catch tables and the 2 to 4 second wait as a first version, so they may change.

If your pack is full

A catch that does not fit is not lost. The status line says Pack full | make room, then reel in the waiting catch, an Inventory full notice appears, and the catch stays on the line.

  1. Keep the rod equipped.
  2. Make room. Open the Pack with E, point at something you do not need and press J to drop one, or Ctrl + J to drop all of that kind. If you are hungry, eating a Raw meat or Venison from the Pack also makes room for one catch. Items on the ground and manual dropping
  3. Close the Pack and right click again to reel in.
Careful. With the Pack closed, J drops the rod itself, and that cancels the line.
Careful. Lines are never saved. Reel in before you leave: a catch still on the line is lost when you quit, load another world or disconnect.

Eat or cook the catch

Raw meat from fishing is the same as Raw meat from hunting. In Survival, when you are not full, R eats the first food you carry, in the order Berries, Venison, Raw meat, Cooked meat, or you can click Raw meat in the Pack to eat it. Raw meat restores 8 hunger and Cooked meat 30, so cook it when you can. Eating (R)

Fire & food 2 recipes
RecipeMakesNeeds
Burn a charcoal pile2× Charcoal
  • 4× Boards of any species (mixable)
Cook raw meat1× Cooked meat

Raw meat restores 8 hunger, Cooked meat 30. A placed cooking stove cooks the same recipe.

Cook raw meat turns 1 Raw meat and 1 Charcoal into 1 Cooked meat in the Craft tab's Fire & food section. A placed Cooking stove cooks it too; see Crafting and recipes.

Fishing on a server

Fishing works on a server, including a world you host, but only in Survival. In Creative it is refused with Fishing on servers requires Survival mode. The rod must be in your own pack on the server. Fishing on a server

  • Each cast, reel and cancel waits for the server. The status line says Waiting for the server's fishing decision until it answers. Just after you join, it may say Fishing waits for your server stock and personal state until your pack arrives.
  • The server uses the same water, wait and catch rules as solo play. Only you see your float and line.
  • If another of your actions is still waiting for the server, the status line says Wait for the server to finish the current action | catch kept. Try again once it has finished.
  • Refusals start with Fishing refused:, for example Fishing refused: Furniture covers that fishing water when furniture stands between you and the water, or Fishing refused: Wait a moment before fishing again after a very quick second click.
  • The server cancels your line if your mode changes, you die or respawn, or you stop carrying the rod, for example Fishing line cancelled | fishing rod is no longer carried.
  • Caught a salmon | +1 Raw meat and similar messages appear once the meat is in your pack. On a dedicated server that saves its world this can take a moment, because the server saves your catch first.
  • A full pack works as in solo play: the catch waits on the line until you make room and reel again. Disconnecting or a server restart drops the line.
